posts.hook: Anthropic's bug hunter is mailing maintainers hundreds of unvetted reports
posts.caption: anthropic's scanner reportedly found 880 critical open-source bugs, plex flaws are being exploited to install malware, coreweave's debt stress is spreading. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic's OSS Scanner reports 880 critical bugs to open-source maintainers
slides.desc: Reports ship with reproducers and patches but ==no human review== first.

terms.gloss: open-source software: code anyone can read, use and change

slides.title: Plex flaws fixed last month are now being exploited
slides.desc: Attackers chain the bugs to run code and install cryptominers and proxy apps.

terms.gloss: software that streams your own video library to your devices

slides.title: CoreWeave's bonds slide into distressed territory
slides.desc: Shares are down 20%+ in a week and the stress is spreading to other AI names.

slides.title: OpenAI races to close a $30B round before Anthropic's IPO
slides.desc: Sources say it could value OpenAI at ==$1.4T+==, ahead of Anthropic's mid-November listing.

slides.title: Microsoft says AI agents should be treated like insider threats
slides.desc: Its argument: frontier models can't be trusted, so agents need tight access controls.

posts.hook: DeepSeek just handed out its own serving playbook
posts.caption: deepseek open-sourced the engine behind its production models, a google cloud outage knocked out banks, salesforce agreed to buy braze, meta's muse share links reportedly leak private chats. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, the stack that runs its production models
slides.desc: Apache 2.0, starts with V4.1-Flash, runs on ==Nvidia and Huawei== chips. KV cache and load balancing stay closed.

slides.title: A Google Cloud outage took down banks and Equifax
slides.desc: HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland and Lloyds were among the services reported down.

slides.title: Salesforce agrees to buy Braze for $5.66B
slides.desc: Braze stock jumped about 50%. It is Salesforce's bet on AI-driven marketing.

slides.title: Meta Muse share links can expose personal and business secrets
slides.desc: Researchers say shared conversations leak data, the opposite of what an unguessable link promises.

slides.title: Eight eMudhra CAs were revoked for compromise with no public explanation
slides.desc: Go now rejects chains with eight distrusted keys. Silent CA failures erode the web's ==trust model==.

terms.gloss: companies browsers trust to vouch that a website is the real one

slides.title: TikTok staff warned execs about child safety, court records say
slides.desc: Depositions claim warnings about minors on Live went unheeded. These are litigation claims, not findings.
